title: China fears AI could help the US find its nuclear missiles
teaser: Chinese military researchers fear that advances in AI could give the United States an advantage in a nuclear confrontation, making it easier for US forces to detect and destroy Chinese missiles. That would threaten China’s deterrence strategy, which relies on the assured ability to retaliate. According to an analysis by The New York Times, researchers at the Academy of Military Sciences in Beijing believe AI could cut US decision-making time from 15–30 minutes to 90 seconds. Against this backdrop, China is studying how to make its weapons harder to intercept.
